descriptions.text: The Scavenger's Daughter. Upgrade Patch. Back Patch. This is a divine item. This is a unique item. This is a fleeting item. You may only affix one back patch at a time. This patch depicts a pile of scary skulls, all stacked up nice and neat. I wonder if there's a story there? If this upgrade patch is affixed to an eligible garment, it will imbue the following upgrades: (Hidden until it is affixed and then worn.) […] Warning #2! This is a divine item. This means it gains differing abilities, buffs, and possibly debuffs depending on your proximity to certain deities and demons. It makes for new and exciting combinations!

recap.text: Carl opens a celestial predator box and gets a divine back patch. He feeds it with duende kills to unlock the Daughter's Kiss, a stomp that shatters sidewalks. He turns a dog-sized iguana to dust and kicks a turkey named Tom with a force like a hole in the world. The patch fills with power near a Demon Prince of Sheol and a goddess, but Carl forgets to activate the Daughter's Kiss.

Soul energy from the previous floor causes Carl Soul Poisoning, which his Emberus ring partly blocks. Carl punches a suffocated concierge shark with Daughter's Kiss, vaporizing the shark and earning the Sushi Smoothie achievement. On a barracks roof, Carl punches J IronFjord until the man has no face. Carl activates Daughter's Kiss and jumps off a second story onto a worm-ridden mage. Akuma tells the Warlord Chat the War Mages found it and warns Carl and Donut about Agatha.

Carl spends the Scavenger's Daughter through a pair of dead kangaroo feet into a kaiju skull, which explodes. Eris makes a random temporary magic permanent for Imani. The upgrade patch doubles lightning damage taken near Taranis but provides immunity to Sheol-based attacks near Emberus. Eris swaps every crawler's inventory with the nearest person, and Donut asks Carl to combine a bomb and an enriched pet biscuit.

beats.headline: A pile of skulls, stacked nice and neat
beats.text: Out of the celestial predator box, opened in the same haul as a prison tattoo kit and a crafting table kit: a divine back patch for Carl's jacket, its benefits varying with whichever deities and certain demons happen to be near. The upgrades it carries stay hidden until it is affixed and worn.
beats.gist: Carl opens a celestial predator box for a divine back patch, tattoo kit, and crafting table kit.

beats.headline: The Daughter's Kiss
beats.text: About ten duende kills fill the essence bar to the top, a sickly brown swirled with yellow and green, like sewage with oil spilled in it. A deep, ominous voice announces that the Scavenger's Daughter has been fed, and a new skill appears: the Daughter's Kiss. Carl spends it on a single fleeing duende, with a stomp. The creature vanishes without resistance, the sidewalk shatters, and the shockwave knocks every other duende flat and breaks a window. There is nothing left to loot. The glow on the patch goes out, and the bar grows each time it is drained.
beats.gist: Ten duende kills fill a sewage-colored essence bar, granting Carl the Daughter's Kiss skill.

beats.headline: One species at a time
beats.text: Three more fills and drains on the walk north, and Carl learns how to feed it. When every soul in the patch is the same species, the Daughter's Kiss hits almost twice as hard, and it carries their trick with it: a charge made of nothing but Howling Gulls releases a scream many times stronger than their own. A dog-sized iguana called a Yuanat, hit with a charged punch, turns to dust and leaves a crater ten feet across.
beats.gist: Carl feeds the patch, which hits twice as hard when filled with one species.

beats.headline: Nearly full
beats.text: Six tokens in, the soul bar for Carl's back patch is almost full, and he has a persistent itch at his neck he suspects is the bar's doing. He has felt no obvious ill effect from the patch, only unease each time the bar nears the top. One or two more kills would let him disperse the power. He holds it instead: spent now, the bar would not refill in time for whatever guards the key, not with only deckmasters to kill on the way.
beats.gist: Carl has six tokens in his back patch soul bar and an itch at his neck.

beats.headline: A hole in the world
beats.text: The Ralphie card has dispelled every spell and muted every minion, and Carl counts as a minion. Then the patch fills: The Scavenger's Daughter has been fed. He cannot cast, but this is a skill, and it lets him. He jumps, aims a foot at Tom, and the turkey looks up and asks, 'Gobble?' The kick feels like a hole in the world. Tom is obliterated with everything around him, the north wall bows out, and the ground tilts toward the cliff. The whole barn begins to slide.
beats.gist: The Ralphie card mutes Carl and minions, but the patch lets Carl kick Tom into oblivion.

beats.headline: She opens her eyes
beats.text: A Demon Prince of Sheol arrives in Cuba, and Carl is close enough to count as being in his presence. The Scavenger's Daughter answers: she opens her eyes and fills with dark power. For as long as the effect lasts, every fire spell Carl casts burns with Sheol Fire instead of the ordinary kind. A quest update comes soon after, asking him to question the prince about who killed Geyrun.
beats.gist: A Demon Prince of Sheol arrives in Cuba, causing the Scavenger's Daughter to open her eyes.

beats.headline: Her eyes stay open
beats.text: A goddess enters the realm, and the patch on Carl's jacket responds: the Scavenger's Daughter's eyes remain open, and she fills with even more power. The same notification brings Ysalte's own contribution, a temporary effect that turns any potion quaffed or handled outside an inventory into vinegar. It also promises the potions will come back as more powerful versions of themselves once she is banished.
beats.gist: A goddess enters the realm, the Scavenger's Daughter's eyes stay open, and Ysalte turns potions into vinegar.

beats.headline: Power left to linger
beats.text: Since the fight in the building, the bar in Carl's interface has crackled with black energy: the Scavenger's Daughter has been fed, and wants her wrath unleashed. He does not unleash it. At the last moment Princess Donut sees the jacket glowing, and says the patch is not an aardvark but a giant centipede crawling through the skulls. A voice in Carl's mind says he should never have let the soul power linger. It needs him alive, and reasonably sane. He had forgotten to activate the Daughter's Kiss.
beats.gist: Black energy crackles in Carl's interface because he did not activate the Daughter's Kiss.

beats.headline: Soul poisoning, and a dead shark
beats.text: The soul energy Carl never spent at the end of the last floor is still riding in the back patch, and it comes due on arrival as Soul Poisoning: jolts of pain, partly blocked by his Emberus ring, with worse effects promised. Saferoom rules cover the city for sixty hours, so nothing alive can be hurt. He finds something dead instead, tosses a suffocated concierge shark into the air and punches it with Daughter's Kiss. The shark vaporises, Carl and Donut are blown back through the mud, and the AI makes up an achievement on the spot: Sushi Smoothie.
beats.gist: Carl punches a suffocated concierge shark with Daughter's Kiss, triggering the Sushi Smoothie achievement.

beats.headline: Fed on the barracks roof
beats.text: An invisible Dreadnaught in a Viceroy mask, J IronFjord, comes at Carl's back on the barracks roof with a glowing dagger. Carl punches him in the chest, rips off the mask, and goes on punching until the man has no face left. A summoned 1970's Death Cult Leader watches and calls it really nasty. The Scavenger's Daughter has been fed. Unleash her wrath. At the end of the fight, when the last worm-ridden mage runs uphill, Carl activates Daughter's Kiss and jumps off the second story onto him.
beats.gist: Carl punches J IronFjord in the chest and face to feed the Scavenger's Daughter.

beats.headline: The War Mages leave with it
beats.text: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat they have found it and are quitting the floor. He uses the same breath to warn Carl and Donut about Agatha.
beats.gist: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat they found the upgrade patch and warns Carl and Donut about Agatha.

beats.headline: Fed, and spent on a skull
beats.text: Mid-race the notification lands: the Scavenger's Daughter has been fed; unleash her wrath. The complication is timing. Carl has to spend it before the finish line or carry it until the next race. So it goes into the kaiju skull at the bottom of the hill: Daughter's Kiss, delivered through a pair of dead kangaroo feet by a man lying on his back on the hood of a food truck. The skull explodes.
beats.gist: Carl feeds the Scavenger's Daughter and spends the upgrade on a kaiju skull.

beats.headline: She opens her eyes for Eris
beats.text: Eris enters the realm and the Scavenger's Daughter opens her eyes and fills with power. The goddess of chaos brings a different effect every time; this one takes a random temporary magic from someone near Carl, not Carl, and makes it permanent. Eris points at Imani and says she will be able to explain it once the goddess has gone.
beats.gist: Eris enters the realm, the Scavenger's Daughter opens her eyes, and Imani gets a permanent random magic.

beats.headline: One aura inside, one outside
beats.text: Inside the boss, the patch does what Rosetta and Mordecai said it would. Beside Taranis: lightning attacks half again as strong, lightning damage taken doubled. In the club, near Emberus instead: immunity to Sheol-based attacks. Khepri, when he is summoned, is too distant to register. The kneepads Penny is wearing give her the same temporary deity effects, and that matters more than anything else they do.
beats.gist: The patch grants lightning attacks and damage effects near Taranis and Sheol immunity near Emberus.

beats.headline: Every inventory changes hands at once
beats.text: Eris fires the effect and each crawler's inventory swaps with whoever is nearest. Donut receives Carl's, and he immediately asks her to combine a bomb and an enriched pet biscuit.
beats.gist: Eris fires an upgrade patch and swaps every crawler's inventory with the nearest person.

relations.note: Standing near him buys ninety seconds of immortality
